'''Sidney Arnold Bludman''' (May 13, 1927 – August 21, 2026) was an American physicist.

== Early life and career ==
Bludman was born in New York on May 13, 1927, the son of Morris Bludman and Lena Saltz. His parents were [[Jews|Jewish]] immigrants from [[Poland]]. He attended the [[Bronx High School of Science]], graduating in 1943. After graduating, he briefly attended the [[City College of New York]], before transferring to [[Cornell University]], earning his [[Bachelor of Arts|AB degree]] in 1945. He served in the [[United States Navy]] in the [[Naval Ordnance Laboratory]], which after his discharge, he attended [[Yale University]], earning his [[Master of Science|MS degree]] in 1948 and his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD degree]] in 1951.<ref name="a">{{Cite web|url=https://www.legacy.com/legacy/sidney-bludman|title=Sidney Bludman|work=Legacy|date=September 1, 2026|access-date=September 4, 2026|via=[[Legacy.com]]}}</ref><ref name="b">{{Cite web|url=https://live-sas-physics.pantheon.sas.upenn.edu/people/emeritus/sidney-bludman|title=Sidney Bludman|work=[[University of Pennsylvania]]|access-date=September 4, 2026}}</ref>

He served as an [[assistant professor]] at [[Lehigh University]] from 1950 to 1952, and worked at [[Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory]] from 1952 to 1961. He served as a professor in the department of [[physics]] at the [[University of Pennsylvania]] from 1961 to 1998.<ref name="a" /><ref name="b" /> During his years as a professor, in 1966, he was named a [[Lists of fellows of the American Physical Society|fellow]] of the [[American Physical Society]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aps.org/funding-recognition/aps-fellowship?q=bludman&af=true|title=APS Fellow Archive|work=[[American Physical Society]]|access-date=September 4, 2026}}</ref>

== Personal life and death ==
Bludman was married to Ellen Schaffer. Their marriage lasted until Bludman's death in 2026.<ref name="b" />

Bludman died at his home in [[Chevy Chase, Maryland]], on August 21, 2026, at the age of 99.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.legacy.com/person/sidney-bludman-62228466|title=In Memory Of Sidney Bludman|work=Legacy|access-date=September 4, 2026|via=[[Legacy.com]]}}</ref>
